texto_para_colar_v3: [excited] Hi! This is your base on Mars. You are in charge!
texto_sem_tags: Hi! This is your base on Mars. You are in charge!

texto_para_colar_v3: [excited] Take care of air, food and health. None of them can reach zero.
texto_sem_tags: Take care of air, food and health. None of them can reach zero.

texto_para_colar_v3: [excited] The real Sun will send surprises. These events come from NASA!
texto_sem_tags: The real Sun will send surprises. These events come from NASA!

texto_para_colar_v3: [cheerful] Hi! I’m Rovi. This is you. Tap the ground to walk (or use the arrow keys).
texto_sem_tags: Hi! I’m Rovi. This is you. Tap the ground to walk (or use the arrow keys).

texto_para_colar_v3: [friendly] An alert sign is blinking on a building. Walk to the door to go in.
texto_sem_tags: An alert sign is blinking on a building. Walk to the door to go in.

texto_para_colar_v3: [friendly] There’s no alert here. Tap Exit and go to the blinking building.
texto_sem_tags: There’s no alert here. Tap Exit and go to the blinking building.

texto_para_colar_v3: [friendly] Tap the computer to see the alert.
texto_sem_tags: Tap the computer to see the alert.

texto_para_colar_v3: [thoughtful] Every choice costs something. Look at the numbers before you choose. Not choosing costs too: the problem gets worse on its own.
texto_sem_tags: Every choice costs something. Look at the numbers before you choose. Not choosing costs too: the problem gets worse on its own.

texto_para_colar_v3: [serious] These bars are Air, Food and Health. If one reaches zero, the mission goes back to Earth.
texto_sem_tags: These bars are Air, Food and Health. If one reaches zero, the mission goes back to Earth.

texto_para_colar_v3: [curious] The antenna gets Sun alerts. They are real events, measured by NASA!
texto_sem_tags: The antenna gets Sun alerts. They are real events, measured by NASA!

texto_para_colar_v3: [helpful] Tap Energy. You share the day’s energy: air, greenhouse (food), lab (science) and shield. If air is low, put more energy into air.
texto_sem_tags: Tap Energy. You share the day’s energy: air, greenhouse (food), lab (science) and shield. If air is low, put more energy into air.

texto_para_colar_v3: [helpful] Use + and - to choose how much goes to each module. If energy runs short, take some from the lab.
texto_sem_tags: Use + and - to choose how much goes to each module. If energy runs short, take some from the lab.

texto_para_colar_v3: [pleased] Nice! Now tap Done to save.
texto_sem_tags: Nice! Now tap Done to save.

texto_para_colar_v3: [friendly] The clock moves when you walk and choose. Solve the alerts and go to bed in the Home before night.
texto_sem_tags: The clock moves when you walk and choose. Solve the alerts and go to bed in the Home before night.

texto_para_colar_v3: [friendly] This is the Home. The bed is inside.
texto_sem_tags: This is the Home. The bed is inside.

texto_para_colar_v3: [friendly] To sleep, leave here and go to the Home, in the middle of the base. The bed is inside.
texto_sem_tags: To sleep, leave here and go to the Home, in the middle of the base. The bed is inside.

texto_para_colar_v3: [warm] This is the bed. When the alerts are done, tap it to sleep.
texto_sem_tags: This is the bed. When the alerts are done, tap it to sleep.

texto_para_colar_v3: [helpful] Yesterday the food went down. Tap Energy and put more into the greenhouse to make more food.
texto_sem_tags: Yesterday the food went down. Tap Energy and put more into the greenhouse to make more food.

texto_para_colar_v3: [helpful] Yesterday the air went down. Tap Energy and put more into the air factory.
texto_sem_tags: Yesterday the air went down. Tap Energy and put more into the air factory.

texto_para_colar_v3: [worried] Air is running out! Go to the Air maker, or open Energy and put more into air.
texto_sem_tags: Air is running out! Go to the Air maker, or open Energy and put more into air.

texto_para_colar_v3: [worried] Food is running out! Go to the Greenhouse, or open Energy and put more into the greenhouse.
texto_sem_tags: Food is running out! Go to the Greenhouse, or open Energy and put more into the greenhouse.

texto_para_colar_v3: [worried] The crew’s health is low! Go to bed early, build shield against radiation and pick choices that care for the crew.
texto_sem_tags: The crew’s health is low! Go to bed early, build shield against radiation and pick choices that care for the crew.

texto_para_colar_v3: [slightly urgent] The Sun is setting and there are still alerts! Solve them fast and go to bed in the Home before night.
texto_sem_tags: The Sun is setting and there are still alerts! Solve them fast and go to bed in the Home before night.

texto_para_colar_v3: [urgent] A solar storm is coming! It brings radiation, an invisible energy that hurts the body. Open Energy and put energy into the shield (sand robot).
texto_sem_tags: A solar storm is coming! It brings radiation, an invisible energy that hurts the body. Open Energy and put energy into the shield (sand robot).

texto_para_colar_v3: [cheerful] The battery is full and energy is left over! Put the extra energy into the lab to earn stars.
texto_sem_tags: The battery is full and energy is left over! Put the extra energy into the lab to earn stars.

texto_para_colar_v3: [thoughtful] Remember that choice with the hourglass? Its cost has arrived now.
texto_sem_tags: Remember that choice with the hourglass? Its cost has arrived now.

texto_para_colar_v3: [worried] There isn’t enough energy for this plan! The lab turns off first, then the shield and the greenhouse. Air is last.
texto_sem_tags: There isn’t enough energy for this plan! The lab turns off first, then the shield and the greenhouse. Air is last.

texto_para_colar_v3: [helpful] Yesterday the lab ran out of energy! In Energy, leave a little free: the cards use energy too.
texto_sem_tags: Yesterday the lab ran out of energy! In Energy, leave a little free: the cards use energy too.

texto_para_colar_v3: [helpful] Tip: the sand robot builds the shield against radiation. In Energy, put 2 energy into the shield before the next Sun storm!
texto_sem_tags: Tip: the sand robot builds the shield against radiation. In Energy, put 2 energy into the shield before the next Sun storm!

texto_para_colar_v3: [slightly urgent] The Sun is setting. Solve the alerts and sleep in the Home before night, or the crew gets tired (-4 health).
texto_sem_tags: The Sun is setting. Solve the alerts and sleep in the Home before night, or the crew gets tired (-4 health).

texto_para_colar_v3: [calm] The Sun is setting. All done: go to sleep in the Home before night so the crew doesn’t get tired.
texto_sem_tags: The Sun is setting. All done: go to sleep in the Home before night so the crew doesn’t get tired.

texto_para_colar_v3: [concerned] Night has come: the crew is tired (-4 health). Each alert left undone costs -2 when you sleep, and the problem gets worse on its own. Go to the bed in the Home.
texto_sem_tags: Night has come: the crew is tired (-4 health). Each alert left undone costs -2 when you sleep, and the problem gets worse on its own. Go to the bed in the Home.

texto_para_colar_v3: [calm] [soft] Sleeping well is part of an astronaut’s job. NASA studies how crews sleep, because being tired causes mistakes.
texto_sem_tags: Sleeping well is part of an astronaut’s job. NASA studies how crews sleep, because being tired causes mistakes.

texto_para_colar_v3: [proud] Mission complete!
texto_sem_tags: Mission complete!

texto_para_colar_v3: [warm] [proud] Your crew made it through every sol on Mars. Great command!
texto_sem_tags: Your crew made it through every sol on Mars. Great command!

texto_para_colar_v3: [calm] Earth sent a ship to bring the crew home
texto_sem_tags: Earth sent a ship to bring the crew home

texto_para_colar_v3: [calm] [reassuring] Nobody got hurt: Mission Control decided to bring everyone back. Let’s find out what happened!
texto_sem_tags: Nobody got hurt: Mission Control decided to bring everyone back. Let’s find out what happened!

texto_para_colar_v3: [calm] [explaining] The air ran out. People breathe all the time, and the air maker needs energy every sol.
texto_sem_tags: The air ran out. People breathe all the time, and the air maker needs energy every sol.

texto_para_colar_v3: [calm] [explaining] The food ran out. The greenhouse needs light (energy), and plants take time to grow.
texto_sem_tags: The food ran out. The greenhouse needs light (energy), and plants take time to grow.

texto_para_colar_v3: [calm] [explaining] Health got too low. Radiation, hunger and lack of air make the body tired.
texto_sem_tags: Health got too low. Radiation, hunger and lack of air make the body tired.

texto_para_colar_v3: [encouraging] Tip: each 1 energy in the air maker makes 4 air. Give it enough for what the crew breathes.
texto_sem_tags: Tip: each 1 energy in the air maker makes 4 air. Give it enough for what the crew breathes.

texto_para_colar_v3: [encouraging] Tip: each 1 energy in the greenhouse makes 3 food. Don’t leave the greenhouse without energy.
texto_sem_tags: Tip: each 1 energy in the greenhouse makes 3 food. Don’t leave the greenhouse without energy.

texto_para_colar_v3: [encouraging] Tip: with 2 energy, the robot adds a shield layer against radiation. And sleep before night so the crew doesn’t get tired.
texto_sem_tags: Tip: with 2 energy, the robot adds a shield layer against radiation. And sleep before night so the crew doesn’t get tired.

texto_para_colar_v3: [happy] You survived!
texto_sem_tags: You survived!

texto_para_colar_v3: [excited] ...and did lots of science!
texto_sem_tags: ...and did lots of science!

texto_para_colar_v3: [very excited] ...and reached the science goal!
texto_sem_tags: ...and reached the science goal!

texto_para_colar_v3: [encouraging] Do more science in the lab to earn more stars next mission.
texto_sem_tags: Do more science in the lab to earn more stars next mission.

texto_para_colar_v3: [curious] [storytelling] Did you know? A ship from Earth can only reach Mars about every 26 months. That’s why planning is everything!
texto_sem_tags: Did you know? A ship from Earth can only reach Mars about every 26 months. That’s why planning is everything!

texto_para_colar_v3: [confident] Got it!
texto_sem_tags: Got it!

texto_para_colar_v3: [confident] Got it!
texto_sem_tags: Got it!

texto_para_colar_v3: [excited] Let's go!
texto_sem_tags: Let's go!

texto_para_colar_v3: [excited] Let's go!
texto_sem_tags: Let's go!

texto_para_colar_v3: [surprised] Uh-oh, an alert!
texto_sem_tags: Uh-oh, an alert!

texto_para_colar_v3: [surprised] Uh-oh, an alert!
texto_sem_tags: Uh-oh, an alert!

texto_para_colar_v3: [sighs] [relieved] Phew... that was close.
texto_sem_tags: Phew... that was close.

texto_para_colar_v3: [sighs] [relieved] Phew... that was close.
texto_sem_tags: Phew... that was close.

texto_para_colar_v3: [cheerful] Good morning, base!
texto_sem_tags: Good morning, base!

texto_para_colar_v3: [cheerful] Good morning, base!
texto_sem_tags: Good morning, base!

texto_para_colar_v3: [yawns] [sleepy] Time to sleep...
texto_sem_tags: Time to sleep...

texto_para_colar_v3: [yawns] [sleepy] Time to sleep...
texto_sem_tags: Time to sleep...

texto_para_colar_v3: [very excited] Mission complete!
texto_sem_tags: Mission complete!

texto_para_colar_v3: [very excited] Mission complete!
texto_sem_tags: Mission complete!

texto_para_colar_v3: [calm] [hopeful] It's okay... let's try again.
texto_sem_tags: It's okay... let's try again.

texto_para_colar_v3: [calm] [hopeful] It's okay... let's try again.
texto_sem_tags: It's okay... let's try again.

texto_para_colar_v3: [worried] Storm coming! Everyone to the shelter!
texto_sem_tags: Storm coming! Everyone to the shelter!

texto_para_colar_v3: [worried] Storm coming! Everyone to the shelter!
texto_sem_tags: Storm coming! Everyone to the shelter!

texto_para_colar_v3: [happy] Wow, a new sticker!
texto_sem_tags: Wow, a new sticker!
